notablePrerequisites: Brago does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked an opponent.
description:
Deal combat damage using Brago.
Brago triggers, blinking Invasion of Arcavios.
When Invasion of Arcavios enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand, or searching your library for Walk the Aeons and putting it into your hand, if needed.
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying {4}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.name: Invasion of Arcavios // Invocation of the Founders
